examples: Start a claude session in your api project to work on a bug while another session keeps building the web client.
Start a codex session beside a claude one on the same folder to compare their answers.
how_to: Click + and pick the agent you want (claude, codex, or another installed harness) with the arrow keys or by typing its name.
Press Enter. Pick or type the project folder it should start in.
The new session opens in the terminal and appears in the drawer.

media.alt: The select provider dialog listing claude, codex and other harnesses
media.caption: Choosing the agent for a new session

name: Create a session
summary: start a new claude or codex session in a project folder, right from the home screen.
where: The + button at the top of the agents drawer.
Or the + beside RUNNING SESSIONS on the home screen, or the + in the menu tab's button row (new session).
